general_approach.description: Network Calculus with CBS service curve analysis
general_approach.WCD_equation: WCD = sum_over_hops(transmission_delay + queuing_delay + switching_delay + propagation_delay) + time_sync_error
general_approach.transmission_delay_equation: L_frame / Bandwidth, where L_frame = payload + 38 bytes overhead
general_approach.queuing_delay_CBS_equation: For CBS with Network Calculus: delay_bound = burst / rate_guaranteed, where rate_guaranteed depends on IdleSlope and competing flows
general_approach.CBS_service_curve: Rate-latency service curve β(t) = R * [t - T]+ where R = IdleSlope * Bandwidth and T is latency term from interference
